source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: My name is Alex M. Onur. I am a 3rd year industrial engineering student in Istanbul. I love playing games, it’s like an addiction to me. When we are together with friends, we enjoy it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Generally MMORPG. But these days I cannot have time for MMORPG. Therefore, FPS games. You have to spare a certain time for MMORPG. You shouldn’t fall behind other players. I have a university life and I’m working at the same time. MMORPG is a summer love for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I have started with Halflife and CS. Probably most male players started with them. I play Valorant now as a competitor game. Other than that, I am familiar with most of FPS games. Probably I have played.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: These games. Other than that, not much.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. These are the basis.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Rust can be an FPS game but it isn’t a competitor game. It’s a type of FPS game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Rust. Other than that, Hunt. Tarkov. These are classified as a type of FPS, not as 5V5. They are like open-world type.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Strategically. I don’t like fighting boldly. I also get bored of support role. I don’t prefer that. But I like thinking and doing strategy in all games such as Hunt-Tarkov type games or Valorant CS type games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. Maybe you’ve heard of “rage” word. When I lose a game, I go into a rage. I yell at my friends. I enter the game to win, not just to have a pleasant time. And when you lose, you lose and there is nothing else you can lose at that time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: As I said, I am a competitor, I pay attention to my rank in most games. It’s my priority. You cannot see me playing a game just for fun. Generally I have an aim. Maybe there was a wipe and then I try to rank up.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It’s the same with the competitive ones, 5V5. Certainly. But in other games such as Hunt and Tarkov and other FPS type games, there aren’t many situations that I go into a rage. Because you finish a game and enter a next one. It’s not that challenging.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: All games I play are classified as FPS but they are different. For instance, CS:GO has patterns of guns so you memorize them. But in Valorant, there is nothing to memorize. You have to calculate the recoil of the gun. It’s the same with other games. Some has, some doesn’t have. So, I see myself above average. I don’t limit myself only with games. I try to improve myself with some applications such as Aim Lab.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Maximum two. I don’t do something functional.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. Not like checking blogs. I follow Twitch, Instagram and YouTube. Streamers share some content. I follow them and get the information.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. Being able to respond momentarily as a reflex. Not against the opponent but during the gameplay, you need to decide what to do momentarily in the map. There are some positions for that. There are people who are expert in this sense, I am trying to improve myself on this. I do strategy myself when we enter the game as 5 people. I think I am successful in that sense.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I don’t follow the ones that my friends follow. There are some pro leagues.  I obverse professional players there and I can play in the same way during the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes, I need to watch and see.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: There are some that I’m actively playing and also some that I’ve experienced before.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Escape from Tarkov is a game that I play actively. Hunt: Showdown, I played it but not actively. The Cycle I saw it but didn’t play. Marauders, probably I’ve tried it because I remember my friends were playing it. Vigor, I haven’t tried. Zero, I haven’t tried. Dark and Darker, I tried it. Also, I watched it. Hell is others, I haven’t tried. I didn’t try Warzone DMZ mode but I watched it. Battlefield Hazard zone, I haven’t tried.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I played PUBG Metro Royale mode. I hear Arena breakout, Lost Light and Badlanders for the first time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I assume it’s been a long time since it was launched. I started it after a long time. My friends were talking about it. But we were distant because of its price. Then, we purchased the game. All of us, 4-5 people paid. Then, we started playing and as we played, we felt immersed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: When we searched about it, people would say it is a really realistic game. It has too many details. They would say that the sounds of weapons are the same with real weapons. We were curious about it. We entered the game. Game has too many details. As far as I know, it is called the most realistic FPS game.  The sounds of weapons are almost the same with real weapons.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It is not a shooter game. But not like a competitive game. It has a unique type. It’s not a Battle Royale. I cannot position it. I need to do a research. At least I can say what it is not.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I haven’t seen such type of game. I want to do a research. Probably it would be something under PVP game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I have experience in two games. Escape from Tarkov and Hunt. Both are based on tasks. In Tarkov, you need to leave from a place after looting and in Hunt, you need to kill creatures on the map. While doing these, you play against other players. They are similar to each other.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Tarkov. In Hunt, you enter, kill, gain your gift and reenter the game again.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: What do you mean by other types?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: As I said, I am a competitor, they are not very attractive for me. And also system requirements etc. affect my thoughts.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I had to purchase Tarkov twice. I can say that we are addicted to it. Because it’s like eating something as a first thing after you wake up. It was like that to us. Playing Tarkov before going bed. We play for 2-3 hours. We feel like we have to play it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Competition. It’s more realistic. You feel like you are in that moment. The atmosphere is really beautiful. Occasionally you go mad because of it. But other than that, these are the things that I feel immersive. Being realistic. Before starting it, everyone is saying that it is realistic. When it met our expectations, we felt that we could play it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. I haven’t played Squad but have seen it. It is not a game for team play. You can play solo. But in Tarkov, you feel the team play. If I am not playing, they invite me. We are always communicating. When we enter the game, we have a purpose. The game dictates that. If you complete that tasks, you gain something. You don’t want to fall behind, you want to do that. Actually, that task system bonds us to the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: As they also play this game, they have the same opinion with me. I have some trouble when I am trying to explain this game for a person who isn’t aware. Actually, there is nothing much complicated. You go, loot and sell the items etc. But the guy asks me the reason. There are 8-9 maps and why do you do the same thing?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. Also, it’s not a game just for a trial. Price is high.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: As I said, I had to purchase Tarkov twice. My first account was limited. After that, 5-6 days passed and I prepared my money. And then I purchased it again.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It took 4-5 months. If I play 3-4 hours on average a day, 500-600 hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Every day. 2-3 hours every day. If we begin from the beginning, we do two raids. Or four-five of them, just to do something on that day.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: We are not only playing Tarkov. We also play other games. When my friends are playing other games, I am playing Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes or if they are already 5 people.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Because it’s still beta. I am sure that I will give 10 when it is launched. But as it is in development, when I see its missing parts, I don’t feel distant to the game. I’m trying to give feedback as much as I can.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It’s not a game that I love playing. If I get bored, I play it. I would give 5-6 to Hunt. I don’t like a game easily. I am aware of almost every game. Therefore, my points would be low.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: You have more things to lose compared to other games. When you lose points when you lose in ranking games. You can earn your points by entering another match. But in Tarkov, you enter the game with your equipment, those could be very precious, if you get killed, it’s over and you cannot get them back. That’s why, you have to be more careful when playing it. Other than that, I have spent less days playing it compared to others. It tires you. Because that stress tires you. You think if you enter the game and die. As it requires more strategy, if I do 2-3 raids in Tarkov, before or after that I play 5-6 matches in Valorant or CS.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: If there was nothing to lose, I would play the game as much as I can.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: For me, it’s attractive. Also, playing too much would make me distant from the game. I play some time but then I quit in order to play it again on the next day.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I think it’s more appealing when you are afraid to play rather than playing a game without purpose.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I like trading. I have done trading in MMORPG games. I also do in Tarkov. I loot and trade them. This is attractive for me. I don’t even talk about its quality and realism as FPS.  I’m focused on more development.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In terms of experience, all attracts me. First I need to loot so that I can trade afterwards. All are connected to each other. If I say that I like killing enemies, it wouldn’t be real. Because I cannot achieve something by only doing that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I like playing sneaky more than boldly. There is factory. It’s a complicated map. When I play there, I like the tiniest sound I hear or guessing my enemies by those sounds. It’s so good. Instead of rushing around, it gives me that experience.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In the beginning, you don’t see the missing parts of game. Because you are like almost hypnotized. The game met all of our expectations and we were like ‘wow’. We didn’t understand the missing parts. But now when I look back, I notice that these features were not there when we were playing. Now, we have those features and it’s easier for us to play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: We started game as 4-5 friends. After that, another 4-5 friends also started. We are looking at them, they were saying the game is really good and we are thinking “were we like this?”

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Strategy. As I said, there are so many things to lose. You have to be careful. Actually, it’s up to you. If you go out very strongly with well equipped, you have so much to lose but if you go with medium quality equipment, you have less risk. In general we would like to guarantee ourselves and we attack with the best weapons and also we would like to experience that stress and adrenaline.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Others don’t have such feeling of aiming and shooting. In CS or Valorant. The flash of the muzzle, he sound of the weapon, recoil… These are the things make the game more realistic. As I said, I hear those real gun sounds.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: We are addicted to the game. I am thinking… It doesn’t take much time but it’s like MMORPG.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Right. Also, I don’t have to that much time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. You asked something else.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: There are equipment that you can achieve at the maximum level. I’m sure that everyone will say that. I want to prove myself in the game.  I haven’t seen or done a research, I am not sure if pro league exists or not. But if there was, I would like to join them. And that would have been my goal.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Matching system is problematic now. As your armor gets tougher, your match becomes stronger. Sometimes it changes. I don’t know about this but matching system is not so successful. It’s a little ridiculous to match upon armor, not level.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. As we have been playing for 5-6 months, we don’t have much problems. When we first played the game, we found three armors by luck, and when we enter with those armors, we lost those armors in the first game. And then we learned this system from the blogs.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Only negative thing could be the time that I kill. I play the game as I like it. I spare my time. Do I do something for it? No, I continue playing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: If I quit, I would probably quit playing all computer games. It’s not specific to Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It may be related to my computer but in terms of optimization, it has some problems. I have some friends who has higher computers. Disconnections after each update make our day a hell. Let’s say regularly 80-90 FPS, after the update, it goes down to 40 FPS. That day is a hell for me. Only thing is that. I don’t have any problems with game play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Other PVP games that I played puts you on the ground and you kill. They are eye catching. But in Tarkov, you really need to use your brain. You cannot kill guys randomly. Rather than just shooting, you have to think from where and how to shoot.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Rather than advantage, it’s a joy. If you like this, you would enjoy. As I said, there are more than 7 maps. We have lots of plans such as A, B plans in each map.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: When you say PVPVE, MMORPG comes to my mind somehow.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. If there is no other classification, they come to my mind.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In general, PVPE games that we have played are not shooter games. We have started giving chance for them. Tarkov is also among them. Both FPS and PVPVE type game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I don’t think that FPS games would directly fit with shooter games. This shooting here satisfies us but I don’t think there would be such details as FPS games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Normally in the shooter FPS games we play such as Valorant and CS, your position on the map and your task are obvious. That’s all. But in Tarkov, situation is different. Your position is different. In Valorant, for instance, we know where a man will show up. But in Tarkov, as people are positioned randomly, it’s more complicated. Is it a good thing? I think yes. It forces you to think more. It keeps you alert. You cannot memorize the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It’s more realistic. You react the same as in the real life.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: An additional dynamic to the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: You can play the game in two ways. You enter as a bot. And with your main character. If you enter as a bot, you can loot and transfer them to your main character. If you enter with your main character, you start from the beginning and play for 40-60 min. It changes depending on the map size. This duration is a bit long for us. You can leave whenever you want. You may leave after you loot. But we would like conclude.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: If it wasn’t, I wouldn’t play it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Of course. It’s more detailed. Things you have to are more complicated. Instead of shooting, you decide a strategy, loot, fight against players, and then you have to sell your findings wisely. It makes more money when you customize it and sell it. You need to calculate these. They may seem simple but the things you can find are more detailed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Having an aim increases your expectations towards the game. I think it’s a good thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In the beginning, I was wondering if the game was realistic or not. After that, not an occupation but it become a lifestyle for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. When I was testing it, I knew that I would play it. Because I researched about it. I guessed how it would be.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Of course. Other games forces you to play on a specific game. You have to play on that map. But in Tarkov, you can be wherever you want and whenever you want you can leave and finish your looting.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: For instance, you can play on the same place and you can achieve something. For instance, you memorize the place of loots or the positions that people may pop up. You may improve yourself. But in other games, for instance, in Valorant, you enter the newest map, you don’t know anything about it. You definitely lose your first match. In Tarkov, you can do a research about that map and you can choose it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It’s about keeping the player in the game. Because it gives a guarantee. For instance, you die with your main character. When you enter as a bot, you already have some equipment such as weapon, and backpack.  Even if you leave without doing anything, you will have something to transfer to your main character. We can think of it as a cheat provided by the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I assume something to prevent something from returning.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: The basic factor is that being able to choose map by myself. Also, there is a shelter mechanism in the game. It’s a freedom for me. I have a home in the game. I improve things there. I improve the size of my inventory. It’s freedom for me. I can decorate. Not much but I can customize things.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I don’t think we can see it as an advantage. Because the aim is different. In FPS shooter games, you shoot with five bullets but you cannot kill. But in this game, it’s possible to kill someone with one bullet. As I said, it’s a difference. A style. I cannot say that Tarkov is better or CS and Valorant are worse in that sense.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It may be an advantage for some people who love realism and want to kill with one bullet. Sometimes it could be very annoying.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In general, the advantage of PVPVE games is this. It gives a role playing. You have a feeling of belonging to that world. The more realistic that world is, the more you feel belonging. And Tarkov provides this with weapons, skins, the sounds.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Because I feel like I live my real life. Not playing a game. When you die, everything ends. It’s the same in real life. You lose everything when you die. You can reborn but you have to reborn as a new person.  I think the most appealing thing in Tarkov is that. Its being realistic.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. In other games, there are rounds. You can die in that round but when you kill 5 people in the next round, you achieve. And it’s over. You don’t fall behind.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Well, not appealing. If you say fantasy themes in another game, I experienced it before. There are games that I love. But I don’t think there is a need for Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: In a different game, yes. I already experienced them in other games. But after a while, I got bored.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: What do you mean exactly by fantasy?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Definitely it shouldn’t be in Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: There are already some fantasy games. But in Tarkov, it’s against the general logic of the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Hunt is freer in terms of this. There are some different and fantastic creatures that you kill. But it fits with the game. It’s already its theme.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: No, definitely. It’s kind of a military game. The only fantastic thing could be something like a zombie outbreak. Something like dystopia could be.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: We fight against bots and people. If there are some zombies that fight against everyone, it could be.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. A fire-breathing dragon has no business in Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Rather than PVPVE, it should be mainly PVE in the beginning. First aim should be fighting against bots rather than real people. It should prepare you for PVP. You need to develop your skills with PVE. After then, you can enter PVP. I think it would be more logical.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It may have a story and tasks. In general mostly people complain that the game doesn’t have a story and the game only directs us only to do something in MMORPG. If Tarkov had the same thing…I’m thinking how it could be…But it would be the same as CS then.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Turning to something else is bad. I’m playing as it is Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It has to have a story. PVE areas should be sufficient. Then it should be a good PVP. I’ve played lots of MMORPG games. I haven’t reached to PVP stage in almost none of them. It was either pay to win or pay to skin. Until I reach to that stage, people already quit the game. It should give a proper PVP chance.  I think that’s my ideal.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: For instance, I would like to see an area that all players gather in Tarkov. I’ve heard that this will be added. Probably after enabling attacking to shelters, they plan to do that. As I said, I trade. When I click on asap button, I can reach it. In a PVPVE game, you need to act with a seller in a place.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Could be something like that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I’m trying to think all not only for Tarkov.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Rank system should be more serious.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I mean rank system. I think the most immersive thing in a game the positive feeling the game provides you. I should give me that feeling.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: They can give awards. For Tarkov, I think pro leagues or e-sports should be taken into account. So that I shouldn’t say that I am the one after a while.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes, if it gives me an objective continuously, it would be better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Generally, most games do not have a fair matching system. It may sound like I am not very well and that’s why I think like this but it’s obvious. I shouldn’t match with a player with 500 hours if I have just played for 10 hours. I’ve experienced all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Actually most games are problematic. My previous account had 500-600 hours. But I’m joining with a new account. Others may say the same thing for me as well. How can this guy shoot like this? But I don’t know how to prevent this…But this is a problem for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I’m thinking the examples. For instance, in Tarkov if I see skin…Tarkov is not open to innovations. I wouldn’t like it in Tarkov. But Hunt is not much complicated. It would be good for Hunt.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. The skins in Tarkov shouldn’t be red, blue or purple. Darker colors would be added if they do.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: There is a thing that we call grind. You don’t look for the thing that you loot. When you grind, you pile them high sell them cheap. Many PVPVE games have this. You loot without looking what you loot and sell them. While doing that, if you gain a precious loot, it would be extra. This is my strategy.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Are we talking about in game?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: I am sure that keeping the price lower at the beginning would be more profitable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes. You need to invest first in order to earn money. There is not much options to earn money from the game now. The only thing they can do is advertising. For instance, when I watch Twitch, I haven’t seen anyone playing Tarkov continuously and regularly or with advertisement purposes. There was a MMORPG game, Lost Ark. All Twitch streamers were playing it. It wasn’t a long term game. I’ve also played for 5 months. But I would continue if I found something immersive. As I said, you need to invest first to earn money. I think Tarkov is not good in terms of this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Actually it is like pay to win which is I don’t like. I also invest money in games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Something which can be gained from looting shouldn’t be sold. It makes a game pay to win. I also invest money in games. But I purchase skins.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Yes, definitely. I abandon game if that happens.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: If the item in the game improves my progress, it shouldn’t. It improves a person who has more money than me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: For instance, I purchase something for 50 TL which normally I should spend 20 hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: Airdrop. It could be because I’m not the only one who could take it. Everyone could take it and you have to fight for it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D6-英文原版
text: It’s logical. I can give an example. In Metin 2, it was launched and after 1 week, there was a store market. There were precious rare weapons and if you purchase them, you will be on the top. And the person who purchased them were on the top. I think this shouldn’t happen. But I am not against skins.
